description:
Apple's Cellular Software team is seeking talented, highly motivated and disciplined engineers to work across layers on groundbreaking cellular technologies. The position involves identifying and/or developing core cellular technologies that solves everyday problems for customers using iPhone, iPad, Watch and other wireless product lines. We are passionate about keeping our users connected 24/7 wherever they go. This team takes pride in not just coming up with proven software designs but also in disrupting traditional models of the cellular ecosystem. We do whatever it takes to bring user experience to the next level. 

Description
Our team members are working on all aspects of Cellular modem Layer 1 control to come up with the best possible performance for any given problem. Are you equally passionate about cellular technologies and have the dream to work on groundbreaking cellular technologies? Then we are looking for you. As part of this team you will impact iPhone user experience worldwide.

Responsibilities
Develop and optimize core cellular technologies for Apple devices (iPhone, iPad, Watch, others)
Work across multiple software layers including cellular protocol stack, Layer1 control and PHY interfaces, as well as close collaboration with system engineering, modem test engineering teams.
Design and implement cellular Layer1 control software solutions that enhance connectivity and user experience
Identify, investigate, and solve complex cellular technology problems
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver reliable, high-performance cellular systems
Contribute to innovation by challenging and evolving traditional cellular ecosystem models
Ensure continuous connectivity and seamless user experiences across Apple's wireless product lines

Minimum qualifications
Proven experience designing, executing and launching cellular modem technology on Phones.
Strong Software Engineering skills including design, programming (using C, C++).
Excellent debugging skills
Bachelors or Masters in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.

Preferred qualifications
Highly motivated and self-directed
Thrive in a collaborative environment and can clearly communicate while confidently driving multiple projects across
Obsessively passionate and inquisitive, and seeks to solve everyday problems in innovative ways.
Laser-focused on the smallest details that are meaningful to our customers.
